text:
eva: FYI ACME reported intermittent 401s and says there's no request id in the response. Asked them for anything they can share.
raj: ok can you ask for the correlator/trace GUID and a minimal curl? easiest to triage. common header names: `X-Request-ID`, `X-Correlation-ID`, `Redwood-Trace`, or `Redwood-Debug-Token`.
eva: pinged customer. they sent a screenshot of the browser response but header column is collapsed. asked them to expand headers or capture a HAR.
maria: if they're on web, HAR is best. ask them to: 1) open DevTools -> Network 2) reproduce 401 3) right click -> Save all as HAR. also ask for exact time and username so we can find server logs.
eva: sent HAR request + exact epoch time (ms) of failure.
ops-bot: reminder: if headers are missing, proxies can strip `X-Request-ID`. check for `via` or `x-forwarded-for` in the HAR to spot a proxy.
raj: engineering checklist for customer HAR/logs:
- one HAR file
- a minimal curl that reproduces (see example below)
- SDK logs (if using our SDK) at debug level for the same timeframe
- exact failure timestamp (UTC)
- any load balancer/proxy hostname
- session id or user id used in request

raj: minimal curl example (redact keys):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
     -H "Accept: application/json" \
     -H "X-Request-ID: <your-guid>" \
     https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
eva: i told them to include the `X-Request-ID` they see (or generate one) and to copy the raw request headers from HAR. also asked them to run the curl above and paste the full `curl -v` output if possible.
maria: mobile SDKs: ask for the SDK debug logs and the `session_marker` printed by SDK (we log `session_marker=<guid>` on init). Android: `logcat | grep Redwood` and iOS: device console logs via Xcode/Console.app.
eva: customer replied: their proxy is mod_security and they suspect header stripping. they attached HAR with no X-Request-ID. only see `x-edge` headers.
raj: if header is stripped, ask them to look for our `redwood-request` cookie or query param fallback (some customers used `?rwid=` during proxy upgrades). also request the server access logs from their edge — look for the timestamp we were given and our host `api.redwood.example`.
ops-bot: note: we can still trace by matching token-subset and timestamp in our logs; ask them for the `Authorization` token prefix (first 6 chars) or client id if using API keys.
eva: i've asked for the prefix and their LB logs. customer asked how to create a debug bundle — they don't know what to attach.
raj: tell them debug bundle should include:
- HAR or curl output
- SDK logs (debug) or server access logs around the timestamp
- a short repro script (curl) that hits the same endpoint
- screenshot of console/network headers if HAR not possible
- note about whether they saw any redirects

maria: include instructions to create a debug token from Console (if they have Console access): Settings -> Support -> Create debug token. It will surface as `Redwood-Debug-Token: <token>` which they can paste into curl header.
eva: customer can't access Console. asked them to run `curl` and copy response headers. i shared the curl above.
raj: if they paste a sample request/response here, redact secrets and we can look for the correlator. if none, eng can try fuzzy-match by timestamp + client ip + request path.
eva: customer attached a redacted curl output — contains `x-edge: 1` and `via: some-proxy` but no `X-Request-ID`. sent them steps to enable passthrough on their proxy or add rule to forward `X-Request-ID`.
maria: for future: if proxies can't be changed, recommend adding `X-Correlation-ID` as a query param on client side and tell them how to map it in server logs. quick snippet for frontend:
```
const id = crypto.randomUUID();
fetch('/v1/generate?rwid=' + id, { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ...' }})
```

raj: closing notes for support escalation: if we still can't find a server-side correlator, open an eng ticket with: customer HAR/curl, timestamp, token prefix, client ip, and any LB logs. tag `eng-infra` and include `log-scan` label.
eva: thanks all — forwarded steps to customer. will post bundle when they send logs.
maria: :thumbsup:
